releases.notes:
✨ **Major Improvements**: Added Happy Ghast damage alerts (#6) and updated documentation/showcase accordingly. This release supports Minecraft Versions `1.21.6`–`26.1.2`.

**Details**:

- **Happy Ghast Damage Alerts**: When your Happy Ghast takes damage, you'll be notified via the actionbar. There are two scenarios: while riding it, or always as the tamed owner.
- **Documentation & Presentation Updates**: Updated the pack/advancement descriptions and README usage docs to include damage alerts, and expanded showcase assets.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/nwrenger/improved-happy-ghast/compare/0.3.1...0.4.0
